Species Database

Cataloged alien flora and fauna from planet Sota7 — with trait profiles, threat assessment, and crossbreeding compatibility notes. Entries marked pre-launch will be expanded post September 8 release.

How to Use This Database

Species entries include: classification (Flora / Fauna), biome, threat level, primary traits (relevant to crossbreeding), interaction notes (how to safely harvest samples), and data status (Confirmed / Pre-launch / Unknown).

Threat levels are: Low (docile or avoidable), Medium (territorial/conditional), High (aggressive on sight).

📝 Pre-launch Database

The game launches September 8, 2026. All species below are sourced from official Steam materials, developer previews, and the August 31 demo. In-game names may differ slightly. Post-launch we'll update species names, exact trait values, and crossbreeding chains.

Scanning Priority Guide

Not all species contribute equally to Research Progress. Based on confirmed pre-launch information, here is the suggested scanning order for maximum efficiency:

  1. Herd Beast — highest Research Progress contribution among early fauna (multiple individuals count separately)
  2. Low-Scrub Fruit Bush — unlocks Greenhouse crop recipe
  3. Orange Stalk Plant — unlocks early crossbreeding compatibility
  4. Teal-Fin Lizard — required for an early EON Corp mission objective
  5. Purple-Leaf Tree — unlocks bioluminescence crossbreeding chain
  6. River Lily-Pad — water trait extraction for Greenhouse upgrade
  7. Red Dragonfly — flying specimen; counts toward aerial fauna research quota
  8. Orange Crab-Fauna — caution required; scan from safe distance first
